policy: Every high or critical advisory fails CI. An entry here is only accepted while the advisory has no patched release and the documented expiry has not passed; the gate re-checks the advisory and fails as soon as upstream publishes a fix, so no exception survives a real upgrade.

exceptions.title: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
exceptions.reason: Affects every published picomatch version (<= 4.0.7), so no upgrade path exists. The vulnerable code path is only reachable through glob patterns; the repo globs fixed, hand-written paths during build and test, never untrusted patterns. Reached transitively via fdir/tinyglobby, @expo/cli, vite and vitest, which is why npm audit reports 27 high package entries for one root advisory.
